steps.title: User prompt
steps.detail: Plan a 3-day trip to Hue and remember it.

steps.title: Intent recognized
steps.detail: Travel planning requires the Trip Planner capability.

steps.title: Specialist selected
steps.detail: Route to Trip Planner :8001 in the ecosystem view.

steps.title: Plan created
steps.detail: The specialist asks for missing details and drafts an itinerary.

steps.title: State tool called
steps.detail: save_trip_detail writes the plan to session state.

steps.title: Artifact returned
steps.detail: The itinerary and state receipt return to the user.

steps.title: Brief received
steps.detail: A short script brief enters the root team.

steps.title: Writing intent recognized
steps.detail: The orchestrator selects Script Team.

steps.title: Draft handoff
steps.detail: Ownership transfers to the Drafter.

steps.title: Critique handoff
steps.detail: The Critic returns structured feedback.

steps.title: Revision handoff
steps.detail: The Reviser produces a new version.

steps.title: Final script
steps.detail: A revision artifact returns with the handoff trail.

steps.title: Question received
steps.detail: A comparison requires facts and calculations.

steps.title: Sports analysis selected
steps.detail: The orchestrator selects World Cup Analyst.

steps.title: Search specialist called
steps.detail: Evidence is retrieved within the stated source scope.

steps.title: Code specialist called
steps.detail: Arithmetic is computed by code.

steps.title: Evidence and calculation aligned
steps.detail: The root agent checks inputs before synthesis.

steps.title: Analyst report
steps.detail: A report returns with separate evidence and calculation trails.

steps.title: Request received
steps.detail: The input is treated as sensitive and uncertain.

steps.title: Synthesis workflow selected
steps.detail: The orchestrator selects Love Advisor.

steps.title: Two lanes run
steps.detail: Independent analysis branches process separate dimensions.

steps.title: Synthesis waits
steps.detail: The synthesis stage starts only after both branches complete.

steps.title: Schema validated
steps.detail: The result is checked against a structured plan schema.

steps.title: Structured plan
steps.detail: A sectioned result returns with safety and uncertainty notes.

steps.title: File preset selected
steps.detail: The static site uses a labeled simulated dataset preset.

steps.title: Data analysis selected
steps.detail: The orchestrator selects Dashboard Insights.

steps.title: Content ingested
steps.detail: A callback and permitted file tools provide context.

steps.title: Framework chosen
steps.detail: The agent selects an analysis lens.

steps.title: QA loop
steps.detail: The report is reviewed and revised for no more than two rounds.

steps.title: Report archived
steps.detail: The result returns with an evidence ledger and archive receipt.
